name: The Little Black Bestiary: A Dragon's Treasure
source:
The player goes on a date with Isabel, a dragon-girl with a small otaku streak. Can romance bloom in the local comic shop? 

[From [url=https://cyberscherzoff.itch.io/a-dragons-treasure]Itch.io[/url]]
